THE FRAME

Four cards set the stage before the story runs:

① PLACE — where it all goes down.

② QUEST — what everyone's chasing.

③ MODE — the rules of trust. This one can be betrayed: if the whole table agrees, the mode flips mid-game and the path shifts. Loyalty was never guaranteed.

④ WINNERS — who walks away on top.

The RAPOPORT STRATEGIES below are game-theory playbooks (Tit for Tat, Grudger, Always Defect…) — ways to cooperate or stab, drawn from the prisoner's dilemma. They colour how the MODE plays out.
